nodes.name: Every 2 hours
nodes.notes: Poll cadence for RSS feeds. Connect: nothing — but change the interval to suit the client.

nodes.name: RSS Read
nodes.notes: Connect: replace url with the client's real feed(s). Use one node per feed, or a Merge node to combine several feeds into one stream.

nodes.name: Dedupe by link
nodes.notes: Connect: nothing. Change dedupeScope to 'workflow' to dedupe across all feeds merged upstream.

nodes.name: Keyword filter
nodes.notes: Connect: replace the regex with the client's keywords. True branch continues; False branch is dropped (or route to an archive).

nodes.name: AI summarizer (stub)
nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: point this at your real AI endpoint (OpenAI, Anthropic, or a local model) and add the API credential. The response should return JSON with hooks/caption/hashtags for the next node.

nodes.notes: STUB — Connect: add a Google Sheets credential and set the real Sheet ID (or swap this node for Notion/Airtable). Columns above are placeholders the operator can rename. This queue is what the Scout→Scribe handoff reviews.
